content.text: It has been a long time I have slept at night, most of the nights I used to stay up. Studing, getting distraded, feeleing dizzy, something following my hobby. And This hobby is making a digital presence, but not of mine, of my works, I never codes for showing off some projects. So today I thought lets start to build something that will work as a repository of all my stories, it did'nt matter if you are someone other than me or my future is reading this, the journey that begin let it be documented.

The start is always messy, imperfect, and full of doubts. But I've realized something important: creativity isn't about waiting for the perfect moment; it's about making time for it. We often wait for the ideal conditions—the quiet weekend, the vacation, the mythical 'someday'—but those moments rarely arrive on their own. But I said to my self :
"You already have wasted that much time so dont worry invest some more and make it happen"

content.text: The the first apperence didn't fascinate me, but it is better to do something than nothing. So here it is, a simple archive built with just HTML, CSS, and JSON files. Simple. Static. Sufficient., initially I do not foucus on the responsiveness. I am just adding elemetns and features to it. after all these thing came to work I work on the responsiveness. Now I connected the git reposity and will push the changes.

Today I just focused on what I loved to, The upcomming exam never firce me. I have done all the pending lecutures of NPTEL, and it is such interesting to learn from the best professors of India. I just love the way they teach, and I am so greatful to them. The topic I have selected is also intersting, Large Language Models, I just love to learn about AI and ML, and how these models are trained. The future is AI, and I want to be a part of it.
